task.title: Task Pulse 功能完善
task.prompt: 用 Hermes 和 OpenCode 完 Task Pulse 仓库的功能，包含任务管理和自动化功能
task.summary:
Here's a summary of all changes made:

## Changes Summary

### Store (`src/lib/task-pulse/store.ts`)
- **Added `approveTask`** - new exported function to approve command/approval requests on tasks
- **Fixed `stopTask`** - kills both `workerPid` and `pid` from file snapshot targets; adds `clearRunner`/`clearSimulation` at top; removes duplicated code
- **Fixed `retryTask`** - adds `clearSimulation`/`clearRunner` and worker log cleanup
- **Fixed `deleteTask`** - uses `unlinkSync` instead of broken `renameSync` for worker log cleanup
- **Fixed `listLiveSnapshots`** - better file filtering and auto-cleans corrupted JSON files
- **Removed** unused internal functions (`scheduleBlockedWatch`, `handleOpenCodeJsonEvent`, `connectLineBuffer`, `mapTextToSignals`, `markRunnerActivity`)

### API Routes (new)
- **`POST /api/tasks/[taskId]/approve`** - new endpoint to approve command/approval requests

### OpenCode Runner (`scripts/task-pulse-live-runner.js`)
- **Fixed `markOutput` bug** - changed `if/return` to `if/else` so the `approval_required` handler actually runs
- **Fixed `step_finish` handler** - now allows `'done'` reason in addition to `'stop'` before marking task complete

### Hermes Runner (`scripts/task-pulse-hermes-runner.js`)
- **Improved phase detection** - broadened Chinese regex patterns (e.g., `分析|理解|评估` instead of just `正在读取`)
- **Added approval keyword detection** in both stdout and stderr streams
- **Added stderr approval handling** with `needsHuman`, events, and notifications

### UI Components
- **`task-detail-client.tsx`** - added "批准命令" (Approve) button for `approval_required` status tasks
- **`dashboard.tsx`** - added `DashboardApproveButton` to task cards when in approval state
- **`dashboard-client.tsx`** - added `DashboardApproveButton` component with approve API call
- Cleaned up unused imports

### Tests (new)
- **`src/lib/task-pulse/__tests__/utils.test.ts`** - 29 tests covering all utility functions
- **`src/lib/task-pulse/__tests__/store.test.ts`** - 10 tests covering all store operations (CRUD, groups, approve)
- **`package.json`** - added `vitest` dev dependency and `test` script

### Results
- **39 tests passing**, **0 lint errors**, **0 lint warnings**
- Full task lifecycle: create → approve → stop → retry → delete
- Hermes and OpenCode runner scripts with proper approval handling and Chinese language support
